meta.title: Gospel Access vs Population Growth
meta.the_question: Is gospel access keeping pace with the population it must reach?
meta.mortality_caveat: est_deaths_per_day applies a NATIONAL crude death rate to a SUB-POPULATION. It is an ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE ESTIMATE, not a count. Crude death rate is not age-standardised. Unengaged groups skew rural and poorer, so the true figure is plausibly HIGHER.
meta.religion_caveat: primary_religion_not_christian is INFERRED from the group primary-religion field, not measured individual belief. 1 of 2,106 DX groups has a Christian primary religion.
meta.boundary: No church, believer or meeting-point data.
